videos.title: The 12,000-Year-Old Temple That Rewrote Human History | Lost Empires
videos.description:
Beneath an ordinary hill in Turkey sleeps something that should not exist: a temple built 12,000 years ago — 7,000 years before the pyramids — by hunter-gatherers who had no metal, no wheels, and no kings. I stood on that hill, and what I found rewrote everything I thought I knew about human civilization.

This is the true story of Göbekli Tepe, the world's first temple — and the mystery of why its builders buried it on purpose.

videos.title: What Really Killed the Maya? 60 Cities, 1 Mystery
videos.description:
Sixty cities died in a single lifetime — and nobody knows exactly why. I walked the jungle-swallowed ruins of Tikal to uncover what really killed the Maya.

The truth is stranger than any single villain: the worst droughts in two thousand years, wars over water, and divine kings who had no answers. But here's the twist most people miss — the Maya never disappeared. Their descendants number in the millions today, still speaking Mayan languages on the same land.

This is the story of how the greatest civilization of the ancient Americas fell — and the warning it carries for us.
